title: Fix CI artifact path handling
intent: Restore the Pytest workflow by making CI-mode CLI artifact outputs resolve to the caller's artifacts directory while preserving supported absolute debt snapshot outputs.

scope.out_of_scope_notes: No analyzer logic, schemas, or test assertions changed.

what_changed: Adjusted CI-mode debt snapshot output handling so relative --out paths resolve from the caller's working directory artifacts/ folder, while absolute output paths remain supported for existing debt snapshot workflows.
Adjusted CI-mode scan output handling so relative --out paths also resolve from the caller's working directory artifacts/ folder instead of the scan target root.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Without this change, CI subprocess tests write snapshot and scan artifacts into the scanned repo's artifacts/ directory instead of the caller's artifacts/ directory, causing missing-file failures in pytest. A separate deterministic debt snapshot contract also requires absolute output paths to keep working.

commands_run: source /tmp/code-audit-ci-fix/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -e '.[dev,api]'

source /tmp/code-audit-ci-fix/bin/activate && python -m pytest -q -o addopts='' tests/test_cli_api_parity_debt_ci.py tests/test_contract_parity_cli_api_scan_ci.py tests/test_debt_snapshot_ci.py tests/test_ci_never_calls_tier_label.py tests/test_cli_requires_ci_flag_under_ci_env.py

source /tmp/code-audit-ci-fix/bin/activate && python - <<'PY'
import os, json, tempfile, shutil, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
repo = Path('.').resolve()
root = repo / 'tests' / 'fixtures' / 'sample_repo_debt'
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
out = tmp / 'snap1.json'
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(repo / 'src')
env['CI'] = 'true'
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'code_audit', 'debt', 'snapshot', str(root), '--out', str(out), '--ci'], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
assert out.exists()
data = json.loads(out.read_text())
assert data['schema_version'] == 'debt_snapshot_v1'
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
PY
test_results: Targeted CI artifact-path pytest coverage passed: 13 tests across debt snapshot parity, scan parity, CI flag enforcement, and CI tier-label guard coverage.
A direct subprocess verification confirmed debt snapshot still succeeds with an absolute --out path in CI mode and writes a valid debt_snapshot_v1 artifact.
verification.notes: The failing GitHub Actions job reproduced as a missing artifacts/snapshot.json file because CLI CI-mode output paths were being anchored to the scan target root instead of the caller's working directory.
